content.about: Dominica is a mountainous Caribbean island covered in rainforest. It has hot springs, waterfalls and a boiling lake. It is called the "Nature Island". It is home to the Kalinago people.

standout.text: Dominica's Boiling Lake is one of the largest hot lakes in the world.

didYouKnow: Sperm whales live year-round off its coast.
The Sisserou parrot is on its flag.
